description: SEPA Flood Maps (Scotland) is a hazard data portal run by Scottish Environment Protection Agency (SEPA). A web map for checking long-term flood risk for an area in Scotland, including future flood maps that can be used to check a planning proposal; it does not cover flood risk for a single property or blocked drains and burst pipes. Coverage: Scotland. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is: not stated on the landing page. Caveats: the landing page mentions no data download or web service and no licence, so it is catalogued as a map viewer whose underlying layers may be published elsewhere. It can support flood hazard screening of assets in Scotland. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30: page text read; the data themselves were not downloaded.
